contract: Remove English singular/plural and invented public-prefix aliases from objectType. Existing exact-token union business_object OR source_table/table_name remains a local search contract; not unique authority resolution. No new typed distinction required for this bounded change.
routes: ledger-options direct --object/--object-type -> proposal/evidence/audit/receipt filters -> sqlite-proposal-methods -> query-builders
compliance-report object scope -> store.listProposals with exact tenant/object token/id
lifecycle-view local filtered selection lists/counts and reports actual selected proposal; not uniqueness proof
constraints: Preserve OR parentheses under tenant/principal/source/object_id AND constraints.
All token values remain bound SQL parameters, including quotes/%/_/schema dots.
Distinct addTableFilter unqualified/public matching remains separate, not silently changed by objectType removal.
No changes to paging/order/count identity or receipt join provenance.

cases.oracle: Supplied invoice matches exact business_object=invoice even source_table=public.invoices; does not independently match only business_object=invoices or source_table=public.invoice.
Supplied public.invoices matches exact source_table only (or exact same business_object); does not match invoices/public.invoice/other.invoices.

business_object and source_table can share a token across two different rows; local search returns both if all other exact filters match. Do not falsely claim unique target or silently select one in query helper.
Tenant/principal/source/id mismatch excludes row even if either OR arm matches. Add malicious collision rows in other tenant/source with same object ID.
Quotes, SQL fragments, %/_ and non-English object names remain exact params, never interpolated, pluralized/casefolded/prefix-added.
Proposal list/count, evidence, query_audit table_name and receipt joined proposal fields use consistent exact condition with original ID constraint.
No objectType retains original optional filter behavior; objectId alone still filters exactly; table option is separately characterized unchanged.

status: Read-only contract and preseal only; no tests run, product or expectation edits.
